blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— State prosecutors have ordered the filing of two cyberlibel charges against a Davao City-based lawyer over a complaint lodged by Surigao del Sur 1st District Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr. The lawyer, Atty. Mary Helen P. Zafra, a resident of Tandag City in Surigao del Sur, but holds office in Davao City, swiftly countered the indictment, accusing the lawmaker of using the courts to retaliate against graft complaints she had filed against his family. In a 24-page resolution dated Nov. 9, 2026, the Office of the City Prosecutor in Tandag City found “prima facie evidence with […]...
